subfields.name: Natural Language Processing
subfields.description_en: Focuses on how computers understand, generate, and process human language; includes terms like natural language generation, semantic compression, topic map, linguistic frameworks, and computational humor.
subfields.description_zh: 聚焦计算机理解、生成和处理人类语言，包含自然语言生成、语义压缩、主题图、语言框架和计算幽默等术语。

subfields.name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
subfields.description_en: Covers AI systems, models, and learning techniques such as generative AI, LLM-as-a-Judge, neural modeling, and inductive programming.
subfields.description_zh: 涵盖人工智能系统、模型和学习技术，如生成式AI、LLM作为裁判、神经建模和归纳编程。

subfields.name: Computer Systems & Architecture
subfields.description_en: Deals with hardware, operating systems, and system design, including processors, memory, buses, and virtualization technologies like interruptible OS and capability-based OS.
subfields.description_zh: 涉及硬件、操作系统和系统设计，如处理器、内存、总线和基于能力的操作系统等技术。

subfields.name: Security & Privacy
subfields.description_en: Addresses cybersecurity threats, data protection, and privacy mechanisms such as cyber-kinetic attacks, differential privacy, and encryption disputes.
subfields.description_zh: 涉及网络安全威胁、数据保护和隐私机制，如网络攻击、差分隐私和加密争议。

subfields.name: Data & Information Management
subfields.description_en: Focuses on data structures, retrieval, storage, and analysis, including databases, information extraction, data redundancy, and data preprocessing.
subfields.description_zh: 聚焦数据结构、检索、存储和分析，包括数据库、信息提取、数据冗余和数据预处理。

subfields.name: Human-Computer Interaction
subfields.description_en: Explores how humans interact with technology, including interfaces, user modeling, accessibility, and ecological interface design.
subfields.description_zh: 探讨人类与技术的交互方式，包括界面、用户建模、可访问性和生态界面设计。

subfields.name: Computational Theory & Algorithms
subfields.description_en: Involves formal models, complexity, and algorithmic concepts such as finite-state machines, entropy, context-free grammars, and computational heuristics.
subfields.description_zh: 涉及形式模型、复杂性和算法概念，如有限状态机、熵、上下文无关文法和计算启发式。

subfields.name: Emerging Technologies & Applications
subfields.description_en: Encompasses cutting-edge applications and experimental fields like Xenobots, AI-driven design, augmented reality, and distributed ledger technology.
subfields.description_zh: 涵盖前沿应用和实验性领域，如Xenobots、AI驱动的设计、增强现实和分布式账本技术。

subfields.name: Pharmacology and Medications
subfields.description_en: Drug classifications, therapeutic uses, and pharmacological mechanisms such as antivirals, antihypertensives, and analgesics; includes ATC codes, drug names, and drug actions.
subfields.description_zh: 药物分类、治疗用途和药理机制，如抗病毒药、降压药和止痛药；包含ATC代码、药物名称和药效信息。

subfields.name: Diseases and Disorders
subfields.description_en: Medical conditions including infections, neurological disorders, cancers, and systemic diseases such as syphilis, bipolar disorder, and sarcoidosis.
subfields.description_zh: 包括感染、神经系统疾病、癌症和系统性疾病，如梅毒、双相情感障碍和结节病等疾病。

subfields.name: Microbiology and Pathogens
subfields.description_en: Microorganisms and viruses such as bacteria, viruses, and fungi, including specific species and viral families like Streptomyces, Zika virus, and Nidovirales.
subfields.description_zh: 微生物和病毒，如细菌、病毒和真菌，包括特定物种和病毒家族，如链霉菌、寨卡病毒和 nidovirales。

subfields.name: Medical Procedures and Treatments
subfields.description_en: Clinical interventions such as surgery, biopsies, injections, and therapies including endometrial biopsy, joint injection, and plasma exchange.
subfields.description_zh: 临床干预措施，如手术、活检、注射和治疗，包括子宫内膜活检、关节注射和血浆置换。

subfields.name: Anatomy and Physiology
subfields.description_en: Body systems and structures such as the endocrine, nervous, and digestive systems, including organs, tissues, and developmental processes.
subfields.description_zh: 人体系统和结构，如内分泌、神经系统和消化系统，包括器官、组织和发育过程。

subfields.name: Genetics and Molecular Biology
subfields.description_en: Genetic mechanisms, gene expression, mutations, and molecular functions such as gene clusters, protein domains, and epigenetic regulation.
subfields.description_zh: 遗传机制、基因表达、突变和分子功能，如基因簇、蛋白质结构域和表观遗传调控。

subfields.name: Medical Education and Institutions
subfields.description_en: Medical schools, research centers, journals, and academic figures involved in medical training and research, such as Stanford, Geisel, and the WHO AWaRe book.
subfields.description_zh: 医学院、研究机构、期刊和学术人物，如斯坦福大学、盖塞尔医学院和WHO AWaRe抗生素指南。

subfields.name: Clinical and Diagnostic Tools
subfields.description_en: Diagnostic methods, laboratory tests, and clinical assessments such as urinalysis, tinnitus retraining, and protein function prediction.
subfields.description_zh: 诊断方法、实验室检测和临床评估，如尿液分析、耳鸣再训练和蛋白质功能预测。
